html:
G'oya

Kirim va chiqim bir xil tuzilishdagi ikki jadval. Ularni UNION ALL bilan bitta harakatlar ro'yxatiga aylantiramiz, chiqimda miqdorni manfiy qilib. Qoldiq esa o'sib boruvchi yig'indi: SUM(...) OVER mahsulot bo'yicha bo'linib, harakatlar tartibida. Tartib uchun yordamchi kind ustuni kerak: kirim 0, chiqim 1.

Yechim

WITH m AS (
  SELECT product_id, moved_on, 0 AS kind, id, qty AS change FROM receipts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_id, moved_on, 1, id, -qty FROM shipments
)
SELECT product_id, moved_on, change,
       SUM(change) OVER (
         PARTITION BY product_id
         ORDER BY moved_on, kind, id
         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS balance
FROM m
ORDER BY product_id, moved_on, kind, id

Namunada unning 3-martdagi harakatlari: avval +50 (qoldiq 120), keyin -80 (qoldiq 40). Tartib teskari bo'lsa, oraliqda -10 chiqardi. Oxirgi ORDER BY oyna ichidagi tartibni takrorlaydi: oyna funksiyasi natija qatorlarini saralamaydi.

Tuzoqlar

UNION bir xil qatorlarni birlashtiradi. 1-aprelda 10 tadan ikki kirim bo'lsa, (1, '2024-04-01', 10) ikki marta chiqadi va UNION ulardan bittasini qoldiradi. id ni ham tanlasangiz UNION qatorlarni yo'qotmaydi, lekin baribir ortiqcha saralash qiladi. Bu yerda UNION ALL kerak.

Oynada faqat ORDER BY moved_on yozilsa, standart freym RANGE bo'ladi: bir kundagi hamma harakat bir xil, kun oxiridagi qoldiqni oladi. 3-martdagi ikkala qatorda 40 chiqadi.

Noto'g'riWITH m AS (
  SELECT product_id, moved_on, 0 AS kind, id, qty AS change FROM receipts
  UNION ALL
  SELECT product_id, moved_on, 1, id, -qty FROM shipments
)
SELECT product_id, moved_on, change,
       SUM(change) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY moved_on) AS balance
FROM m
ORDER BY product_id, moved_on, kind, id

kind siz faqat id bo'yicha saralash ham xato: kirim va chiqim id'lari alohida sanaladi, 1-chiqim 5-kirimdan oldin tushib qoladi.

PARTITION BY product_id unutilsa, shakar qoldig'iga unning harakatlari ham qo'shiladi.
